text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc's McCann-Erickson Worldwide unit on Tuesday said it acquired the Ludgate Group, a public relations firm that specializes in financial and investor relations issues.

London-based Ludgate generated 1996 fees of more than $15 million. Ludgate Communications, the British group of the international company, is the second-largest adviser in Britain on mergers and acquisitions. Ludgate also has offices in other European countries as well as in North America and Asia.

Ludgate will operate with its existing management in place after the acquisition, and "the Ludgate brand will be further developed as the specialist, global brand for financial and corporate public relations and investor relations," McCann-Erickson said in a statement.
